page_title: CAG 3-0 VEN | Cagliari v Venezia 18/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

88' Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and leaps to connect with a cross from the corner kick. He produces a fine header, but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
87' Davide Nicola has decided to substitute Michel Adopo and he is replaced by Nicolas Viola (Cagliari).
87' We are about to witness a subsitution. Nicola Pintus (Cagliari) for Nadir Zortea.
85' Venezia have been awarded a corner kick.
84' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
82' Cagliari force their opponents to concede a corner.
82' Cagliari failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The referee signals a corner kick to Cagliari.
75' Here's the change. Kike Perez leaves the pitch and Issa Doumbia (Venezia) comes on as a substitute.
75' Here is a change. Alessandro Deiola is going off and Davide Nicola gives the last tactical orders to Razvan Marin (Cagliari).
74' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Antoine Makoumbou walks off the pitch to be replaced by Matteo Prati (Cagliari).
71' 3 - 0 Goal! Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) is teed up on the edge of the box by Antoine Makoumbou, and his howitzer of a shot into the top right corner gives the keeper no chance. 3:0.
70' Substitution. Mikael Egill Ellertsson walks off the pitch and Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) comes on as a substitute.
70' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Joel Schingtienne is replaced by Francesco Zampano (Venezia).
70' John Yeboah goes off the pitch and Mirko Maric (Venezia) comes on.
67' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
63' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) launches himself at a lofted pass, but his close-range header flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.

60' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Gianluca Busio (Venezia), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
58' The referee blows his whistle, Venezia are awarded a corner kick.
57' Problems for Davide Nicola as Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Gianluca Gaetano replaces him.
56' The corner from Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) is hurriedly cleared.
56' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. Cagliari earn a corner.
54' Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.
52' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Venezia.
48' A corner kick by Cagliari is thwarted by the well prepared Ionut Radu (Venezia). The ball goes out of play. Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.

48' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. Good work from Cagliari as they win a corner.
48' Venezia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
47' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alessio Zerbin (Venezia), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Venezia will take a corner.
46' Referee Luca Pairetto blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+3' Venezia have a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
43' Luca Pairetto sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
43' Maybe there was an infringement in the build up to the Cagliari goal as the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
41' 2 - 0 The corner from Nadir Zortea goes into a dangerous area and finds Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari), who outjumps the defence and glances a header into the back of the net. 2:0.
41' The ball is out of play. Cagliari will have a chance to score from a corner.
39' Cagliari force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
38' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
32' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) is substituted due to injury. Eusebio Di Francesco gives a chance to Christian Gytkjaer.
29' John Yeboah (Venezia) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target.
24' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
16' Venezia get a corner.
14' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

11' 1 - 0 Perfectly taken free kick!Tommaso Augello sends a cross in and Yerry Mina (Cagliari) leaps high to connect with it on the edge of the 6-yard box. His close-range header goes low into the middle of the net and the score changes to 1:0.
9' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
4' Jay Idzes (Venezia) is yellow-carded.
4' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
3' The linesman points to the corner flag, Cagliari are going to take it.
2' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
1' The players are on the pitch and Venezia will have the kick-off.
1' The match has just started.
Luca Pairetto got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
